description: FIX_INDIRECT_STATIONARY (ships OFF): a unit whose ranged output is mainly [INDIRECT FIRE] Remains Stationary instead of making its planned Normal move when the spotted shot is worth more — 11e 10.07: an [INDIRECT FIRE] attack at a target the unit cannot see gets the target the benefit of cover (13.08) and fails on an unmodified 1-5, but only on 1-3 if the unit Remained Stationary (09.04) and a friendly unit sees the target. Same position as exam mv09: Custodian Guard Beta carries a constructed BS 3+ [BLAST, INDIRECT FIRE] mortar, its only target (Custodian Guard Alpha) is Hidden in area-medium-35 (13.09 as errata'd) more than 21" away, and our Prosecutors on obj_center see it. With tests/bench_profiles/indirect_stationary_on.json loaded, the real Suggest (K) card for Beta reads 'Custodian Guard Beta remains stationary to arm its indirect fire at Custodian Guard Alpha (Prosecutors can see it ...)' with the 'How this turn's move was shaped' notes (the 1-3 vs 1-5 band, the spotter, the progress given up). Clearing the profile restores the shipped default: Beta's planned Normal move toward obj_home_2. Reloading restores the stay; executing it leaves Beta unmoved with remained_stationary set and the engine's fail band at 1-3. The guard: Custodian Guard Delta, same spotter and target but a BS 5+ lobba (6+ after the indirect cover either way, 02.02.01), is still suggested its Normal move.

steps.script:
# Close-up: Beta on the west edge, the Prosecutors on obj_center and the
# Hidden Custodian Guard Alpha in area-medium-35, framed between the game log
# and the K card (41% of the width).
var m = tree.current_scene
m.focus_on_world_point(Vector2(740.0, 1190.0), false, Vector2(0.41, 0.5))
var vs = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
# focus keeps zoom >= 0.75; two notches out (1.15x each) fit Beta's left edge
# and Alpha's right edge between the log and the card.
m.zoom_camera_notch(false, Vector2(vs.x * 0.41, vs.y * 0.5))
m.zoom_camera_notch(false, Vector2(vs.x * 0.41, vs.y * 0.5))
return true
